en.p: A function $f(x)$ continuous on the set of all real numbers satisfies $f(x)\ge 0$ for every real number $x$, and $f(x)=-4xe^{4x^{2}}$ for $x<0$. For every positive number $t$, the equation $f(x)=t$ in $x$ has exactly 2 distinct real roots; let $g(t)$ be the smaller and $h(t)$ the larger of the two roots. The two functions $g(t)$, $h(t)$ satisfy, for every positive number $t$,
When $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{7}f(x)\,dx=e^{4}-1$, what is the value of $\dfrac{f(9)}{f(8)}$? [4 points]
